ready.title: Ready to ship
ready.info: Every order with garments that are ready and on no shipment yet, by customer. Tick orders of one customer: they go in one shipment. The box beside a customer ticks all its orders. Then pack and send in Warehouse.
ready.answer: Tick orders of one customer. They go in one shipment.
ready.readOnly: Your role reads this list; sales and the shipping person plan the shipments.
ready.empty: Nothing is ready to ship now.
ready.together: These orders can go in one shipment.

held.noRight: Your role does not plan shipments
held.pick: Tick the orders of one customer
held.twoCustomers_other: Orders of {count} customers never travel in one shipment: tick the orders of one customer
held.tooMany: At most {max} orders go in one shipment

ships.title: Shipments
ships.info: Every shipment, the newest first: Open (a draft or packed), On the way, Arrived, or All. Open one to pack it, to move garments between parcels and to type the tracking numbers.
